bio: Run by the Hämmerle family, this restaurant enjoys great popularity, so it is advisable to book well in advance! With a friendly country house feel, charming service and great food, this place is a nice alternative to the gourmet restaurant. Made with plenty of local produce, the dishes served here are seasonal with occasional Mediterranean touches. The wide-ranging menu includes their Original Wiener schnitzel and sea bass with rosemary and thyme. In summer, make a beeline for the terrace....
